sentences.text: This circular revises the charges in clause 7.4 of the Example UCB Retail Loan Policy v3 and comes into force on August 1, 2026.

With effect from August 1, 2026, a foreclosure charge of 3% of the principal outstanding shall be levied on floating rate home loans to individuals for non-business purposes, including loans sanctioned on or after January 1, 2026.
Foreclosure charges on fixed rate term loans shall be 2% of the amount prepaid.
Penal charges for delayed payment of an EMI shall be ₹750 per month and shall not be added to the rate of interest.
Branches shall disclose all these charges in the Key Facts Statement given to the borrower.
The document is issued by the Chief Executive Officer (fictional).
